turns.patient_response: Yes, absolutely. Even just getting a reminder text makes my heart pound and my hands sweat, giving me this overwhelming urge to escape. To avoid that feeling, I constantly make excuses to cancel, and on the rare times I do force myself to go, I sit in the parking lot shaking and crying until my sister talks me through the door.

turns.patient_response: It is definitely the medical settings themselves, like walking into clinics or having to lie in those big imaging machines, rather than blood or needles. I have never fainted or felt like passing out; instead, my heart pounds, my hands sweat, and I get this overwhelming, shaky urge to just run away.
